info.title: Portal Research Preflight API
info.description: P08 same-origin immutable data-snapshot and effective-spec preflight. The browser receives bounded metadata only: no HMD rows, snapshot path, private adapter URL, principal, source credential, sealed-holdout values or worker admission. This contract does not submit or execute a run.

post.summary: Create one actor-scoped immutable preflight manifest

201.description: A new immutable manifest token and metadata-only effective specification

get.summary: Read the exact live actor-scoped preflight manifest metadata
Read the research dataset catalog (Screen 02 data step)
get.description: CG-P08-04. Same-origin and read-only; the private P08 adapter lists names and month partitions of the approved historical source. It never opens a data file.

Problem.description: Typed same-origin failure. No raw market data, source path, private transport, credential or worker state is disclosed.

RequestedSpec.description: P02 requested spec. v1 is the frozen P02 structural contract; v2 adds rolling train width, temporal guards and causal inner folds. Admitted P10 profiles determine execution support. Authenticated intake separately validates at most 64 sparse native optimizer overrides: n_trials, seed and early_stopping_rounds must agree with top-level optuna_trials, random_seed and early_stopping respectively. optuna_trials and random_seed are not native override keys. Cross-field equality is enforced by intake, not JSON Schema alone.

Quality.description: Observed-tape integrity does not certify a trading calendar: expected session gaps remain unknown/null, not zero.

guards.description: CG-P02-02: engine-built label-horizon, purge and embargo spans (requested-spec v2 plans only).

inner_fold_count.description: CG-P02-02: nested inner folds the engine built inside this outer IS.

window_mode.description: Rolling appears only on an engine-built requested-spec v2 plan with a train width (CG-P08-02).

plan_source.description: Present exactly when the engine's own fold planner built this plan (requested-spec v2).

scope.const: per_study_per_fold_per_seed; no product-wide trial claim is implied

ceilings.description: CG-P08-05: the ceilings this preflight was checked against; sources are published on the Atlas release (preflight_limits).

may_create_run.description: Caller-specific server admission for creating a run from this preflight. P08 is preflight-only and currently returns false for every caller; P10 may return true only when its create route enforces the identical server-side predicate. It is never inferred by the browser from token, lifecycle or role.

details.description: CG-P08-03: the failed gate and requested-spec field path of a 409 refusal, or every invalid field path of a 400.

GapScan.description: CG-P08-06: per-window missing-bar scan of the sealed snapshot's timestamps (never prices). The sealed holdout is not scanned per window. Severity per gap run is not published by the source; a window verdict is WATCH when it misses any bar and CRITICAL above the snapshot quality profile's max_gap_ratio.

HoldoutSeal.description: CG-P08-06 (DR-01): the read-only holdout seal record P08 can prove, or NOT_DECLARED for an advanced walk-forward. Nothing reads sealed values; unlock authority is DR-01 (OWNER_SCOPE_REQUIRED); no certificate cap is published (CG-P04-05). The sealing actor is the preflight's authenticated caller (manifests are actor-scoped) and the time is issued_at_utc_ms.

PreflightGate.description: CG-P08-03: one server check this immutable manifest passed, projected from the stored documents. NOT_RECORDED marks a gate the manifest predates; it is never shown as PASS.

FieldPath.description: Requested-spec key path (never a value), e.g. ["walk_forward", "train_window"]; Screen 02 maps it to the owning wizard step.

RunAdmission.description: CG-P08-03: the P10 predicate behind may_create_run, with its typed reason and field path when it is false. A manifest the predicate cannot load stays an opaque false with null code.

DatasetCatalog.description: CG-P08-04: read-only, bounded research dataset catalog for Screen 02. Public timeframes use lower-case day tokens (1d); the HMD reader's 1D is the same fixed interval. Older uppercase tokens remain accepted for compatibility. Datasets, timeframes, availability and, where the approved reader's storage layout is mounted, symbols with month-partition coverage. No path, row or price; exact bar availability is decided at preflight.
